name: BoolODE interaction strengths
description: BoolODE interaction-strength table consumed as the interaction_strengths file. Each row adjusts the ODE threshold for one regulator-target interaction.
example:
Gene1	Gene2	Strength
g4	g6	10
g3	g2	0.2
validation_notes: BoolODE interprets Gene1 as the target and Gene2 as the regulator in the pinned implementation.
Strength must be a positive numeric value used to scale the Hill or Heaviside threshold for that interaction.
Interaction strengths affect simulator dynamics but do not add new regulatory edges beyond those present in the Boolean model rules.
